name: agentextension
description: Reviewable coding changes in VS Code, powered by local TrueForge.

agentextension.model.description: Model name from TrueForge, including the provider prefix.

agentextension.compaction.description: Let TrueForge compact long histories. Disable this if your model template requires an original user message.

agentextension.turnTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a streamed TrueForge turn.

agentextension.workerTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for each worker session, including one retry. Local models may need 120 to 180 seconds.

agentextension.inlineSuggestions.enabled.description: Experimental. Offer inline code suggestions from the selected model. Off by default; can be set per language.

agentextension.inlineSuggestions.mode.description: Manual suggests only when you run Trigger Inline Suggestion. Automatic suggests while you type; its latency target is not yet measured.

agentextension.inlineSuggestions.maxRequ.description: Most inline suggestion requests per hour in this window.

agentextension.inlineSuggestions.model.description: Optional TrueForge model for inline suggestions on an existing server. Empty uses the main model.

agentextension.executionEnvironment.description: Where checks run. Isolated uses the host sandbox. Container uses Docker with dependencies from package-lock.json or requirements.txt; it never falls back to the host.

agentextension.container.allowLifecycleS.description: Allow package install scripts (npm lifecycle scripts, Python source builds) during container dependency setup. Setup is the only step with network access.

agentextension.fallbackModel.description: Optional second TrueForge model used when the primary model fails.

agentextension.skillRoots.description: Approved local folders containing skill-name/SKILL.md directories. Each declared script needs separate approval to run.

agentextension.scriptNodeExecutable.description: Absolute path to the Node.js executable for isolated skill scripts and custom plugin hooks. Requires desktop macOS or Linux with bubblewrap.

agentextension.readConnectors.description: Workspace MCP connections. Configure exact read targets and optional approval-only write tools. Use HTTPS or loopback HTTP and manage accounts with the Connector credential button.

oauth.description: Optional OpenID Connect sign-in using a registered public desktop client and a loopback redirect.

writeTools.description: Each write needs fresh approval for its connector, account, target and arguments.

agentextension.localReadConnectors.description: Isolated local MCP servers for interactive reads. Each call requires approval. Configure a Node.js executable, a standalone server file, its SHA-256, and exact read tools and targets.

node.description: Absolute path to the installed Node.js executable.

entryPoint.description: Absolute path to a self-contained .cjs server file.

agentextension.pluginRoots.description: Approved local folders containing plugin directories with plugin.json. Review and enable a plugin's version, content digest, and capabilities under Tools → Plugins.

agentextension.browserOrigins.description: Exact HTTPS origins or loopback HTTP origins available for explicit browser access. Select origins and interaction mode in the panel. No wildcard origins.

maxTokens.description: Input plus output tokens across the agent and its workers. 0 means no limit.

maxMinutes.description: Run time in minutes. 0 means no limit.

maxToolCalls.description: Editor tool calls, including worker calls. 0 means no limit.

agentextension.runBudget.markdownDescription: Limits for one agent run. After a limit is reached, only `review_changes` still runs, so staged work can be reviewed. At 125% of the token or time limit the run is cancelled.

agentextension.userInstructions.markdownDescription: Optional standing instructions sent with every agent run, for example your preferred test command or writing style. Up to 4,000 characters. Instructions cannot grant tools or change approvals. Workspace settings cannot set this value.

agentextension.automaticSkills.description: Match up to two approved skills at run start and let the agent request eligible skills during a run. Skills marked disable-model-invocation or allow_implicit_invocation: false require manual selection.

agentextension.permissionRules.markdownDescription: User permission rules for every workspace. Each rule has an `effect`, a `target` with `*` wildcards, and a `decision` of `allow`, `ask` or `deny`. Administrator rules apply first. Allow rules are limited to `command.execute`, `connector.read`, `browser.write`, `browser.navigate` and `computer.write`, and need a specific target. Workspace settings cannot set this value.

agentextension.scheduledReports.description: Enable the VS Code schedule timer and schedule controls. Separately approved background schedules are managed by the local runner.

agentextension.browserExecutable.description: Optional absolute Chrome or Chromium executable path. Empty uses installed Google Chrome. The extension always creates its own profile.
